arguments.assumptions: Scenario assumptions, not consensus or observed multiples. FY2026 is the disclosed 53-week period. GAAP diluted EPS cases are annual: bear $70.00, base $72.00, bull $74.00. They begin with reported GAAP first-nine-month EPS of $41.40 and therefore imply Q4 EPS of $28.60/$30.60/$32.60 under a constant diluted-share approximation only; actual diluted shares may differ. Management's Q4 GAAP EPS outlook is $30.73 plus or minus $1.00, so bear is below the guidance range and tests memory pricing/margin or demand/supply friction; base lies within the stated range and assumes delivery near guidance; bull is above the range and tests better pricing/mix and operating execution. Q4 is disclosed as a 14-week quarter and FY2026 ended September 3 but had not yet been reported as of the fixed evaluation date; it is a provisional historical annual estimate, not future-year growth. P/E assumptions are 10x/14x/18x, explicit hypothetical stresses rather than fair, normal, current, or probable multiples.

cases.rationale: Annual EPS assumption; Q4 residual $28.60 is below management's stated GAAP guidance range, testing a miss from weaker memory pricing/mix, margin conversion, or supply/trade friction.
Annual EPS assumption; Q4 residual $30.60 lies within management's GAAP guidance range and assumes delivery near that outlook.
Annual EPS assumption; Q4 residual $32.60 exceeds management's stated GAAP guidance range, testing stronger pricing/mix and operating execution in the disclosed 14-week quarter.
